name: vateron-media/xc-vm
description: XC_VM IPTV panel — Composer autoloader (PSR-4) deployed as /home/xc_vm/. Regenerate with `composer dump-autoload` from this directory; never run `composer install` on the deploy path (vendor/ is committed and shipped).

post-install-cmd: @php -r "fwrite(STDERR, \"[xc_vm] NOTE: vendor/ is committed and shipped. Use 'composer dump-autoload' to regenerate; do not run 'composer install' on the deploy path.\n\");"
post-update-cmd: @php -r "fwrite(STDERR, \"[xc_vm] NOTE: vendor/ + composer.lock are committed. Commit them after updating dependencies.\n\");"
